Name: Beeri, Father of Hosea
Summary: Beeri is named only as the father of the prophet Hosea (Hosea 1:1). Nothing else is told of him; his place in Scripture is as the father of a prophet whose own family became God's sermon to Israel.
KeyStory: Beeri's only mention is as Hosea's father, in the opening line of his son's prophecy.
LifeLesson: Beeri is a reminder that some saints are remembered for one thing only: raising a child God would use. That is no small legacy.
